purpose: Three US-stock foundational article covers and three explanatory body illustrations

body.prompt: Create ONE landscape 16:9 article-body explanatory illustration, 1536x864 preferred. Use the attached reference ONLY for its tactile ivory/navy/mint-green 3D object style, NOT its large headline, SafePal subject or presenter. Warm cream subtly paper-textured background, navy leather wallet, thick ivory paper certificates, gentle gold edges, matte ceramic surfaces, soft short shadows, restrained physical miniature objects. Topic: a securities account contains both cash and held securities; total account value is not all spendable cash. Composition: a wide low open ivory document case is the meaningful account container. Inside, left a navy/cream wallet with a few neutral banknotes labelled '现金', right a neat stack of ivory securities certificates labelled '持仓'. Above the case one slim navy summary tab labelled '账户总值', connected with fine muted mint lines to BOTH wallet and certificate stack. At right outside the case a small navy clipboard with a magnifier and short label '下单前核对'; no approval tick, no outgoing coins, no promise the whole case can buy stock. Label under case '教学示意'. Keep typography small and planar, not a dominant poster title. No numerical data, no actual platform UI, no company logos, no random arrows, no extra bank building. Leave upper right 20% x 12% clear for later exact brand signature insertion. Do NOT generate any signature, watermark, person or '@Wise' text. Objects occupy center 65% of height with full silhouettes and generous safe margins. Accurate relationship and restrained editorial illustration, not glossy white platinum glass.

visualReview.method: 实际逐张查看 6 张最终 WebP，包含最终签名和压缩结果，不只检查生成原图。
visualReview.account-balances: 米白账户容器内现金钱包和持仓凭证分区；账户总值连接两者，下单前核对板独立。文字清楚，无金额或实际平台 UI。
visualReview.order-flow: 部分成交图明确 2 股订单、1 股已成交、1 股仍待成交；等待支路用虚线与沙漏，不暗示必然全部成交。原图把撮合画成银行，已用 image_gen 局部修正为票据撮合托盘。
visualReview.money-flow: 入金和出金两行，各自对应银行汇出/收款匹配/券商入账，以及卖出成交/结算与提取条件/银行实收。未给固定到账时间。
visualReview.covers: 三张均沿用白金银白玻璃风格；标题、副标题、主要物件在640x360可读，未裁断或拉伸。
visualReview.signature: 6张右上角均机械叠加原始 @Wise Invest 与人物组合，宽度16%，完整保持比例；只对成图副本加圆角，原始签名 SHA256 未变。
visualReview.scope: 仅图片和提示词记录，未改文章正文或共享配置。
